summary: DEFSEC Technologies Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting its third-quarter fiscal 2026 results via a news release dated August 13, 2026. The filing discloses financial highlights including revenue up 92% year-over-year to C$2.72 million, gross margin improvement to 33.1%, and a cash plus receivables position exceeding C$5.8 million. It also announces product commercializations (Lightning 2.0, ARWEN ammunition) and completion of U.S. Army testing of its BLISS system with an invitation to a further evaluation. This is a routine earnings and operational update, not a special situation. No deals, tender offers, or strategic actions are involved.
